blocks.text: Carpet Removal Services in Richmond Hill, Ontario — The Broadloom Era Is Ending, One Room at a Time

c: Richmond Hill was built in the wall-to-wall years. The subdivisions of the eighties, nineties and two-thousands came carpeted everywhere — bedrooms, stairs, hallways, basements — and now, street by street, all of it is coming up for hardwood and vinyl plank. The tear-out is the part nobody wants: heavy rolls, hidden staples, dusty underpad, stairs that fight back. So that’s the part we do. One free in-home quote, one flat price, and a fully insured crew that cuts, rolls, pries and hauls until the subfloor is swept and ready for the installers.

blocks.text: Bayview Hill to Oak Ridges, Mill Pond to Jefferson — Richmond Hill's Flooring Wave Runs Through Us

The conversion is visible on every street: nineties broadloom leaving Bayview Hill's big two-storeys, builder carpet exiting Jefferson and Oak Ridges ahead of plank installs, and older homes near Mill Pond and Crosby finally freeing their hardwood from decades underneath. Live Junk Free handles the tear-outs — 660+ five-star Google reviews earned by leaving subfloors the installers compliment.

items.title: Priced by the truckload, not the square footage games

blocks.text: Rolled carpet, underpad and debris get measured against truck space — one bedroom is a small load, a whole two-storey is more — and that's the entire bill. No per-stair charges, no square-foot formulas that mysteriously round up, and no difference between Richmond Hill neighbourhoods.

items.title: We quote after seeing the floors, not the floor plan

blocks.text: Two homes with identical layouts can hold very different tear-outs — double underpad here, glued-down sections there, a staircase wrapped like a gift. One free in-person look produces one flat figure that already knows what it's dealing with.

items.title: The number survives whatever's under the carpet

blocks.text: Tear-out labour, hauling, disposal fees, fuel — all locked inside the approved quote. When the underpad turns out to be glued or the staples number in the thousands, the price doesn't move. Under-carpet surprises are our specialty and our problem.

items.title: Stairs and second floors are the job, not the exception

blocks.text: Richmond Hill's housing stock means carpeted staircases and full carpeted upper floors are the standard tear-out here — winders, landings, spindle-lined edges and all. Our crews strip them clean, staples included on request, without a mark on the railings or walls.

items.title: Free quote, zero pressure, your installer's schedule respected

blocks.text: No deposit, no expiry, no hard sell. Approve the number and we start cutting; book us for two days before the install and the subfloor will be waiting, swept. Coordinating around flooring companies is half our calendar.

items.title: Independent pricing — 30–50% under the franchise haulers

blocks.text: The national brands price royalties into every job. We're locally owned with none, and Richmond Hill tear-outs land 30–50% cheaper for the identical swept subfloor.

Frequently Asked Questions About Carpet Removal in Richmond Hill, ON

items.q: Q: How is carpet removal priced in Richmond Hill?
a: A: By the truck space the rolled carpet, underpad and debris occupy — small loads from $125, single rooms at the low end, whole-home tear-outs scaling flat from there. The figure is confirmed free and in person before any cutting, and nothing found under the carpet can change it.

items.q: Q: Do you remove carpet from stairs, including winders and wrapped edges?
a: A: It’s our most-requested Richmond Hill job. Straight runs, winders, landings and fully wrapped staircases all strip clean — staples pulled on request — with railings, spindles and walls untouched. Two-storey homes are the local standard, and so is this work for us.

items.q: Q: Will the subfloor be ready for my flooring installer?
a: A: That’s the finish line we work to: underpad up, tack strips out, staples pulled on request, adhesive scraped where needed, and the whole surface swept. Book us a day or two before the install and the crew walks into a ready room.

items.q: Q: Can you lift old carpet without damaging the hardwood underneath?
a: A: Carefully, yes — it’s a favourite job. Older Richmond Hill homes often hide original hardwood under decades of broadloom, and we lift the carpet, pad and staples with the wood’s survival as the priority. What’s revealed is usually worth the wait.

items.q: Q: My basement carpet got soaked — how fast can it come out?
a: A: Wet carpet is a priority call: soaked broadloom and pad start harming the subfloor within days. Same-day removal runs across Richmond Hill whenever slots allow — call +1 647 922 5865 and say it’s a water job.
